description: Open Microsoft work-account sign-in when status says signedIn:false, the user explicitly requests reconnection/account change, or an authentication error requires interactive sign-in. This signs in only; copilot_studio_select_environment establishes the cloud service connection. When signedIn is false, call this directly as part of carrying out the user's request: the browser sign-in prompt is the user's own confirmation, so do not ask for separate approval in chat first. Ask first only when this would replace an existing signed-in session, because that clears the current account, environment and connector setup plans. Do not call for an already-ready session merely to start another task, or just to select an environment.
name: copilot_studio_connect
title: Sign in to Copilot Studio
